entries.title: Joshua 17:1
segments:
Gilead and Bashan; countries on th east of Jordan and north of those allotted to the tribes of Gad and Reuben. 
 
The various talents of men come from God, and he allots to them such situations as are suited to the duties to which he calls them.

entries.title: Joshua 17:2
segments: The rest of the children of Manasseh; those not provided for on the east of Jordan.

entries.title: Joshua 17:4
segments: It is proper that daughters should have an inheritance as well as sons, and so far as is consistent be provided for according to their wants.

entries.title: Joshua 17:5
segments: Ten portions; after the children of Machir had received Gilead and Bashan, there remained the six other sons to be provided for on the west side of Jordan.  Five of these received one portion each; and for the daughters of Zelophehad the son of Hepher were provided five portions more, making ten in all.

entries.title: Joshua 17:9
segments: The river Kanah; a small stream which formed the boundary between Manasseh and Ephraim, and empties into the Mediterranean south of Caesarea.

entries.title: Joshua 17:11
segments: In Issachar--Asher; within the limits of those tribes.

entries.title: Joshua 17:12
segments:
Could not; for want of faith and the use of due means. 
 
It is often said in the Bible that men "cannot" do that which they will not try to do, nor use the means by which, through the blessing of God, they can do it.

entries.title: Joshua 17:13
segments:
Tribute; an annual tax, in token of submission. 
 
Through sloth and inactivity, men will often sacrifice great future good for the sake of a little present ease.

entries.title: Joshua 17:14
segments: One lot and one portion; they claimed a double portion on account of their number.

entries.title: Joshua 17:15
segments:
Get thee up; take possession of those portions of the country allotted to you, which have not yet been subdued. 
 
Men are often in want because they neglect to use proper means to obtain relief, and the best way to help such persons is to put them in a way to help themselves.

entries.title: Joshua 17:16
segments: The valley of Jezreel; these words seem to include both the large plain south-east of mount Carmel, and south-west from mount Tabor, called by the Greeks Esdraelon, and also the valley of the Jordan.

entries.title: Joshua 17:18
segments:
The mountain; the hilly country before spoken of. 
 
  Drive out; this they could do in reliance on God.
